entries.title: Merging outside Infinitary finishes ready tasks here too
entries.body: Infinitary notices when you merge a task's pull request elsewhere. It closes the task only when its crewmate declared that merge finishes the work; unfinished tasks stay open. An unreachable computer's working copy is removed when it reconnects, with unpublished work saved first.
entries.noPicture: The change is automatic task closure and deferred cleanup after an external merge, not a new visual surface.
